purpose: Distinguish a fixed learned actuation sequence from observation-dependent feedback at the already audited b01 restart.
action_sequence_definition: the 800 applied_omega endpoints from role=ppo, steps 1..800, encoded as little-endian float64 for SHA
comparison: existing audited b01 feedback and zero branches; no policy call, action selection, amplitude tuning, or frequency tuning
interpretation: This is a single-start post-hoc discriminator. Similar performance does not invalidate the implemented feedback loop; it means feedback superiority is not established.
